method: Each page is rendered and every card-like box in the content area (180 × 100px or larger, with a background or border, outside the header, footer, menus and pop-ups) is measured. Corner radius 8px or more counts as rounded (WDS 2.0); under 8px counts as sharp (WDS 3.0). A page is 2.0 at 70% rounded or more, 3.0 at 30% or less, and Mixed in between or when it has both an all-rounded and an all-sharp section. WDS 1.0 is identified by its legacy shell rather than corner radius: those pages are served from tekion.ai, use Inter instead of Tekion Sans, and contain none of the tekion-design-system components that every tekion.com page has.
